state.seed_assertion: Security risks assessment should include sources of risk and potential impact of each type of breach including illegitimate access, modification, or loss of personal data.

sentences.1: A DPIA must identify potential impacts on data subject rights in case of illegitimate access, unwanted modification, or disappearance of data.
sentences.2: Potential impacts on the rights and freedoms of data subjects are identified in case of events such as illegitimate access to data, an unwanted modification of data or their disappearance
sentences.3: The DPC will respond to a submission for statutory prior consultation within a period of up to eight weeks, where it appears that the intended processing would infringe the provisions of the GDPR or Data Protection Act, or that the controller has insufficiently identified or mitigated the potential risks.
sentences.4: Processing that poses a risk of physical harm to individuals in case of personal data breach requires a DPIA.
sentences.5: Where the processing is of such a nature that a personal data breach could jeopardise the [physical] health or safety of individuals.
sentences.6: Invisible processing occurs when personal data is obtained from sources other than directly from the individual and privacy information required by Article 14 is not provided.
sentences.7: The ICO may advise against processing or issue formal warnings if it considers processing would breach GDPR.
sentences.8: In some cases we may advise you not to carry out the processing because we consider it would be in breach of the GDPR.
